name: Classic Envelope
desc: The original: an envelope opens and the ivory card rises under a Mughal arch.

name: Palace Doors
desc: The original: carved palace doors swing open beneath hanging lanterns.

name: Golden Medallion
desc: The original: a golden ring draws the couple's initials, then the card blooms open.

name: Faisal Mosque Dawn
desc: Islamabad at dawn: the Faisal Mosque draws itself in fine line against the Margallas.

name: Badshahi Nights
desc: Lahore's Badshahi Mosque lights up dome by dome above its reflecting pool.

name: Departure Board
desc: An airport split-flap board flips to your names, event and date. Status: on time.

name: Wax Seal Letter
desc: A brass stamp presses a wax seal and a letterpress card slides from a linen envelope.

name: Vinyl Record
desc: The needle drops on a record with your names on the label.

name: Constellation
desc: A star map of the wedding night: the stars align into your initials.

name: Countdown Calendar
desc: Tear-off calendar pages fly away until the wedding day is circled.

name: Save the Date Dart
desc: Calendar pages tear away, then a dart thunks into the wedding day: save the date!

name: Alhambra
desc: Granada's lace-stucco arches and a reflecting pool lead to the card.

name: Pressed Botanicals
desc: Pressed flowers laid on cotton paper with a typewritten herbarium label.

name: Love Map
desc: Two pins, one dotted route: a paper plane brings you both to the venue.

name: Vintage Typewriter
desc: A vintage typewriter types your invitation line by line - ding!

name: Hot Air Balloons
desc: Balloons rise at sunrise over Cappadocia carrying your names.

name: Origami Cranes
desc: A sheet of paper folds into a crane and a flock carries your initials.

name: Gold Foil Press
desc: A letterpress stamps your names in shimmering gold foil.

name: Polaroid Memories
desc: Polaroids of the dulha, the dulhan and the date develop on a string.

name: Sheesh Mahal
desc: Lahore Fort's palace of mirrors: light hops chip to chip until the wall glitters.

name: Shalimar Bagh
desc: Fountains switch on across Shalimar's pools and the names rise from their reflection.

name: Moving Miniature
desc: A Mughal miniature comes alive: the baraat procession reaches the palace gate.

name: Dulhay ki Sawari
desc: A painted truck carries the baraat: bells, chamak-patti and "Baraat aa rahi hai!"

name: Shaadi Wala Ghar
desc: The wedding house lights up: fairy lights tumble down the haveli and the street glows.

name: Phoolon ki Chadar
desc: Through the bride's eyes, walking under the flower canopy to the stage.

name: Phulkari
desc: Golden silk is embroidered stitch by stitch, then drapes like a dupatta.

name: Mithai ka Dabba
desc: Open the sweet box: each mithai reveals the date, time and venue.

name: Qalam aur Siyahi
desc: A calligrapher's qalam writes the Bismillah in Nastaliq ink, right to left.

name: Dhol Drop
desc: Beat-synced bold words: SHAADI / PAKKI / HAI! with the names on a drum roll.

name: Doli Rukhsati
desc: The doli glides in at dusk and its curtain lifts to reveal the dulhan.

name: Baraat on Horseback
desc: The dulha rides in on a decorated white mare as the dhol beats.

name: Couple Walk-in
desc: Dulha and dulhan walk in under a floral arch, then the curtains part.

name: Save the Date
desc: A calendar flips to the wedding day, then the envelope opens.

name: Blessing Verse
desc: "And We created you in pairs" (78:8), then the royal scroll unrolls.

name: Shahi Farman
desc: A royal Mughal scroll unrolls with the invitation written on it.

name: Paper-cut Arches
desc: Layered paper-cut Mughal arches; the camera flies through them.

name: Golden Star
desc: An Islamic eight-point star draws itself and opens like an iris.

name: Jharokha Window
desc: Carved jaali shutters open and warm light pours out.

name: Peacock Fan
desc: Peacock feathers fan open around a golden medallion.

name: Storybook
desc: An embossed book opens and its pages turn to the invitation.

name: Kaleidoscope
desc: A jewelled kaleidoscope turns around the couple's initials.

name: Rose Bloom
desc: A giant rose unfolds petal by petal, then scatters to the card.

name: Phoolon ki Larhi
desc: Strings of jasmine and roses hang like a curtain and part.

name: Watercolour Bloom
desc: Soft watercolour washes and line-art roses paint in.

name: Mehndi Hands
desc: Henna draws on two hands with the couple's initials hidden in the palms.

name: Truck Art Shaadi
desc: Vivid Pakistani truck-art panels with bells swing open.

name: Gift Box
desc: A wrapped gift bounces, pops open with confetti and the card rises out.

name: Love Birds
desc: Two doves carry a silk ribbon with the couple's names.

name: Fireworks Night
desc: Atishbazi bursts over the skyline with the names in gold.

name: Fairy Lights
desc: Strings of lights ripple on and a chandelier lowers.

name: Lahore at Dusk
desc: The sun sets behind Badshahi-style domes and minarets.

name: Dulha Dulhan Royal
desc: Groom's name, dulha, dulhan and her name pop in, then the palace doors open.

name: Dulha Dulhan Moonlit
desc: The couple's portraits, then a crescent rises over Lahore with floating lanterns.

name: Dulha Dulhan Curtains
desc: The couple's portraits, then velvet curtains part on a jharokha card.

name: Bismillah & the Couple
desc: Bismillah calligraphy, the couple's portraits, then the envelope opens.

name: Dulha Dulhan Medallion
desc: The couple's portraits, then a golden ring draws the initials.

name: Shaadi Confetti
desc: The couple's portraits, an envelope, golden confetti and swinging bells.

name: Royal Curtains
desc: Velvet curtains with gold fringe part on a carved jharokha arch.

name: Emerald Darbar
desc: Emerald velvet backdrop and a golden medallion under a jharokha.

name: Black & Gold Luxe
desc: Gold glitter, a drawn medallion and an art deco frame on black.

name: Bismillah Curtains
desc: Bismillah calligraphy, then the royal curtains open.

name: Wine & Pearl
desc: Palace doors open on a card draped with pearl strings.

name: Kashi Tiles
desc: Lahore's blue kashi tiles: lapis and turquoise with a golden medallion.

name: Peacock Mor
desc: Teal and gold peacock tones behind carved doors and paisley buti.

name: Pietra Dura
desc: White and gold marble with Mughal inlay colours.

name: Rose Garden
desc: An envelope over red rose petals, opening to rose-corner bouquets.

name: Motia Gajra
desc: Jasmine buds, pearl swags and falling motia flowers.

name: Blush Peonies
desc: Soft blush peonies, floating hearts and rose corners.

name: Marigold Mehndi
desc: Genda strings, marigold garlands, bells and tumbling marigolds.

name: Vintage Garden
desc: Vintage floral paper texture on the card with falling rose petals.

name: White Roses Noir
desc: White roses on black, a minimal monogram and falling jasmine.

name: Moon & Lanterns
desc: A crescent rises over the Lahore skyline as lanterns float up.

name: Chand Raat
desc: Bismillah, then the moonlit skyline, a jharokha card and sky lanterns.

name: Crescent Dusk
desc: A real crescent at dusk behind the envelope, with sky lanterns.

name: Fairy Light Mehfil
desc: Warm fairy-light glow behind the envelope and twinkling bulbs on the card.

name: Starry Nikah
desc: A starry sky, a golden ring and a clean monogram card.

name: Lahore Sunset
desc: Sunset tones over the Badshahi skyline, lanterns and a jaali card.

name: Minimal Monogram
desc: Pearl and platinum, a monogram crest and lots of calm space.

name: Art Deco Night
desc: Palace doors, a 1920s gold frame and gold confetti.

name: Marble Minimal
desc: A white marble card, a golden ring and a simple frame.

name: Black Marble
desc: Black marble behind the envelope, an art deco card and gold dust.

name: Handmade Paper
desc: A cotton-paper card, garlands and soft petals.

name: Mehndi Bells
desc: Truck-art brights, marigold garlands, bells and tumbling marigolds.

name: Kashmiri Saffron
desc: Saffron and gold with paisley buti and corner flourishes.

name: Terracotta Haveli
desc: A backlit Mughal jaali, terracotta tones and a jharokha card.

name: Lilac Dreams
desc: Lilac and silver moonlit skyline, pearl swags and floating hearts.

name: Mint & Rose Gold
desc: Mint curtains, rose-gold corners and rose petals.

name: Powder Blue Walima
desc: Powder blue and silver, pearl swags and falling jasmine.
